meta.how: subagent reads SKILL.md, uses scripts/search.py and data/

answers.density-full-band-top: Up to 2.5%: analyzer.js keywordDensity gives full (best) points from 1% up to 2.5%; above 2.5% it fails with 0. The KB's 1-1.5% is only a recommendation.
answers.density-good-points: keywordDensity is worth max 6 points; 0.8% falls in the 'good' band (0.76-<1%) and gets 3 points.
answers.length-1500-points: 1,700 words falls in the >=1500 tier, so 4 points out of a maximum of 8 (8 needs >=2500 words).
answers.title-points-zh: 38 points (it is 36 only when the site locale is English); zh_TW sites get 38.
answers.media-featured-plus-3-youtube: 3 out of 6: the featured image counts as 1 image (1 point) and 2+ videos give 2 points (3 YouTube embeds = 2), total 3/6.
answers.media-three-images: 4 points (out of 6): 3 images incl. the featured image score 4.
answers.power-words-zh-skipped: No. Rank Math's titleHasPowerWords needs a power-word list for the site locale, and the plugin ships lists only for de, en, es, fi, fr, hu, id, it, ja, nl, sv - no Chinese list - so the test does not apply and drops out of both score sums.
answers.wordcount-cjk: 1 word: wp.wordcount 'words' counts whitespace-separated tokens, so an unbroken run of Chinese with no spaces counts as one word.
answers.howto-duration-valid: No. hasDuration, days, hours, minutes are real block.json attributes and save() ignores them, so they do not break validation; they only deviate from the moksaweb.com site form (post 8594), which is a site-style issue, not an editor error.
answers.howto-save-classes: (a) step wrapper: div class="rank-math-howto-step"; (b) step title: class="rank-math-howto-title" (in the titleWrapper tag, default h3); (c) step content: div class="rank-math-howto-content". The outer wrapper is wp-block-rank-math-howto-block.
answers.howto-multiple: No - only one HowTo block per post. It is decided by block.json supports.multiple: false.
answers.in10-threshold: Above 400 words: with 400 words or fewer the whole text is checked; above that only the first 10% of words.
answers.faq-default-sizeslug: (a) FAQ block: sizeSlug default "thumbnail"; (b) HowTo block: sizeSlug default "full".
answers.verifier-word-gate: It passes from 600 visible (wp.wordcount) words, taken from Rank Math's lengthContent test, whose lowest scoring tier (>=600 words -> 2 points) is the pass threshold.
answers.site-howto-sizeslug: sizeSlug "large" (plugin default is "full"), taken from moksaweb.com reference post 8594 (site style, not a Rank Math requirement).
answers.internal-vs-external-points: linksHasInternal is worth 5 points; linksHasExternals is worth 4 points.
